segments.ja426:1.1: Khamanīyaṃ yāpanīyaṃ, kacci mātula te sukhaṃ;
segments.ja426:1.3: Sukhaṃ te ammā avaca, sukhakāmāva [sukhakāmā hi (sī. syā. pī.)] te mayaṃ.
segments.ja426:2.1: Naṅguṭṭhaṃ me avakkamma [apakkamma (ka.)], heṭhayitvāna [pothayitvāna (ka.)] eḷike [eḷaki (syā.), eḷiki (pī.)];
segments.ja426:3.3: Pacchato tuyhaṃ naṅguṭṭhaṃ, kathaṃ khvāhaṃ avakkamiṃ [apakkamiṃ (ka.)].
segments.ja426:4.3: Tāvatā mayhaṃ naṅguṭṭhaṃ, kathaṃ kho tvaṃ vivajjayi.
segments.ja426:5.1: Pubbeva metamakkhiṃsu [metaṃ akkhaṃsu (sī. pī.)], mātā pitā ca bhātaro;
segments.ja426:6.3: Migasaṅgho palāyittha, bhakkho me nāsito tayā.
segments.ja426:8.1: Neva duṭṭhe nayo atthi, na dhammo na subhāsitaṃ;
segments.ja426:8.3: Nikkamaṃ duṭṭhe yuñjetha, so ca sabbhiṃ na rañjatīti.
segments.ja426:12.1: Parisuddhā manāvilā vatthadharā, bakarājassa kāyuraṃ daṇḍavaro;
segments.ja426:12.3: Atha aṅgāra cetiya devilinā, atha āditta gaṅgā daseḷakināti.
